When Eun-Ho heard that the fabric softener given to him by his ex-girlfriend was discontinued, he left a complaint at the company’s customer center while drinking. Soo-In reads the complaint and is shocked and delivers all the remaining fabric softener samples. Somehow they became close and fell in love. But for Soo-In, Eun-Ho’s ex-girlfriend was too strong of a force. There was nothing she could do for him other than hug him tightly when he was sad. So now it has to be revealed. She is the one who deleted his memories. 

(Source: Manta, edited)

For those fighting discrimination. 

Why does systemic discrimination go unnoticed? Who are the people who stand to benefit from hatred? What if remaining neutral ultimately means you're siding with the oppressors? Follow this story about discrimination, equality, and the fight for justice through the eyes of four different characters! 

(Source: Manta)

Archduke Gabriel de Luzia is cursed. Since his seventh bride died in a tragic accident, he's become an outcast and has stayed holed up in his castle. His only companions there are his loyal servants, until the day a young woman comes wandering right through the castle's protective magical barrier! Having traveled all the way from her village, Marianne has a favor to ask of Gabriel, but nothing comes for free in this world, and what the archduke asks of her in return could put her life at stake! 

(Source: Tapas)

Chae Eun-Soo just wants a stable life with no drama. After a wild night out leads her to sleep with a man she’s just met, she's relieved to find that he only slept next to her… and nothing more. When she runs into him again, he reveals his desperate need for some shut-eye, which only Eun-Soo could induce. He asks if they could sleep together again, and while he seems polite, she soon learns he’s not just a random stranger, but Seo Do-Jin, a boss from her company! So much for a drama-free life!

(Source: Tapas)

description:
After being rejected by her unrequited love, the usually carefree Narae decides she needs to redeem her self-esteem. A normal girl by day, at night Narae now transforms into "BJ Nari," the cosplaying livestreamer! It doesn’t matter that she got rejected, she’ll show her adoring fans how sexy she is! Things start heating up when a mysterious user named “Aooya” proposes something naughty to Narae on her livestream. Hesitant at first, she’s a true exhibitionist at heart and gives her fans what they want. As she gets deeper and deeper into the world of live streaming, will Narae be able to resist the temptations that await her?

(Source: Lezhin X)

description:
Mable Ra Robin, once a duchess to house Quintrell, disappeared without a trace. 5 years later, she shows up at her family's house in the middle of the night. But her name was no longer Duchess Quintrell, she's now Lady Robin because she left her husband. But there's one more surprise, she brought a boy with her. The name is Patrick, and he's the child of a heartless duke and her ex-husband, Percival De Quintrell. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

description:
In high school, Cheol-Ho's obsessive behavior towards Jin-Tae led to a fateful comment: ""I'll consider it if you ever turn into a girl."" Years later, as adults, their paths cross again under shocking circumstances. Jin-Tae wakes up one day to find his body has inexplicably transformed. As they navigate this new and twisted dynamic, Jin-Tae must confront his transformed identity and the dangerous desires Cheol-Ho harbors. Will Jin-Tae find a way to reclaim control over his life, or will he be ensnared by Cheol-Ho's possessive grip?"

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Princess Renia Alesdubois had finally found happiness with her husband Clovis Jenoff, the Grand Duke. But when the empire finds her guilty of her husband's murder amidst political chaos, a dying wish to set everything right sends her back before it all began. Armed with memories of the past, Renia decides to call off her engagement in order to save her beloved. As she goes to extreme lengths to keep the past from repeating, she finds that some things are not at all what she expected. 

(Source: Tapas)

Cheong-Yeon Ham thought he finally got the opportunity of a lifetime! The rich heiress of a powerful conglomerate offered all the luxuries money could buy in exchange for participating in a flashy sham marriage. But Cheong-Yeon soon realized that it was all a trap! His brother-in-law, Do-Eum Yoon, masterminded the whole affair as an elaborate scheme to enact his revenge decades in the making. And his method of doing so? SEX! Nasty sex! But is there more than meets the eye? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

description:
Chan-Woo owns a coffee shop in Seoul. His little brother Jung-Min is living with him while he looks for jobs. These two brothers share something in common. They both have the hots for one Da-Yeon Sung. She’s a childhood friend of theirs and now lives in Seoul as a model. Jung-Min’s the one who got there first however, and is now dating Da-Yeon. Looks like Chan-Woo has to just wonder what could have been… But Jung-Min’s cheating ways end up bringing Da-Yeon into Chan-Woo’s arms. And when Jung-Min discovers the two together, things look like they’re about to get ugly. But…is this really happening? Is seeing his brother sleep with his girlfriend really turning him on?! Still, Jung-Min can’t let his brother get away with this. Like the bitter taste of caffeine, these sexy thrills can be dangerous but addicting...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

But he never receives true affection until he meets a boy by the name of Joon-Hyuk injured on the street. Against all expectations otherwise, Ji-Han takes Joon-Hyuk in as his roommate. But little does Ji-Han know that this chance encounter will change his entire life...

(Source: Lezhin US)

After their mother’s tragic passing, sisters Yeonmi and Hwiyeon want nothing more than a happy life away from their awful step-father. But it turns out that living alone and earning money is harder than it looks! Thank goodness for their mother’s adoptive brother, who swoops in to save them from certain-failure. He sets them up with both a place to live and a food truck license, and finally their dreams of happiness and independence seem to be in their grasp. But it turns out that their uncle might not be the sweet and unassuming savior that he seemed, and he’s certainly not the only one with dirty laundry… Just what will these two get up to in their quest for happiness?

As the biggest nerd on campus, Leslie Glass’s chances of randomly hooking up with a cute hottie are dwindling daily. Desperate for love, she turns to online dating. She finds a guy who’s exactly her type, but “FWB?” “BDSM?” Those words in his bio mean nothing to her. Little does she know that her online pretty boy is none other than Jack Offerman, the talk of the campus. Plus, she doesn’t know that he…really likes getting pegged. Will Jack be the perfect person to guide Leslie through the confusing, but oddly alluring, world of BDSM?

Eunkyung's homelife is... boring, to say the least. With no job, no kids and a distant husband, she's beginning to feel depressed. Things start looking up when her hunky young nephew moves in, but having all that extra testosterone in the house proves stressful! To relieve her tension, Eunkyung decides to take up yoga - only to find out her nephew is the instructor! She's got a lot to learn, and he's a very thorough instructor. Who knew yoga was so hands-on?! 

(Source: Lezhin X)

description:
Yeonji, the tenacious breadwinner of her family, had a bite-filled one-night stand with Joonwon. He reappears six years later, this time as the infamous Vice President of her company. Struggling as a temp, she clumsily tries to avoid his attention until Joonwon plops her into his personal office. Strangely enough, he won't let her forget any detail from that night. Will he drag her into the twisted politics of his life?

*"This time, help me, Miss Nam" … "I don't know if one night will be enough."*

Does he want her body or something more? And how will her past come to haunt her? In this ever-twisting romance, Yeonji might experience enticing excitement or bittersweet heartbreak.

Lee Youngsoo has been single her whole life and doesn't believe in love. One day, a dating app pops up on her phone, saying that she has a 98% success rate with a guy. She decides to try it out, but sadly ends up losing the guy to someone else. Furious, she goes to the app's office, where she runs into an old man. As night falls, he turns into the moon god Wolyoung Seon and says that they are destined to be together. Everyone is fated to be with someone, but who knew her someone would be a god?

Yeon-Ho Kang is a veterinary student with a strange ability: communicating with animals. Ironically kicked out of his residency program because of this, Yeon-Ho is imposed to figure out how to get back on track, until he is offered a chance to work as a school nurse.There, he meets a strange and mysterious girl named Yeoul, a "feral child," unlike anyone he has ever seen before. Yoon Bom-bit loves one thing above all else – dating simulation games. Her most recent obsession? One day, Bom-bit starts her computer up, only to be transported into the world of the game – and inside Mariette’s body! With this newfound chance, will Bom-bit be able to help Anette finally get the happy ending of her dreams?

But thankfully, the only person who sees through her disguise is Marquess Ludvig Vert, her new captain and the first man she ever kissed. Now, as they work together to carry out secret missions for the good of the empire, Arhin can't help but feel like he's giving her special treatment. Is the marquess's favoritism a good thing, or will it totally blow her cover?

One might think being engaged to Hadius Myer, the son of one of the most prestigious families in the kingdom, sounds like a fairy tale, but for Emilia Bern, a commoner, her reality is nothing but a nightmare. Tired of the constant criticism she receives from other nobles and her fiancé’s cold attitude, all Emilia wants now is to end this charade. But when Hadius turns 19, his attitude suddenly changes. The truth is, Hadius has always been in love with Emilia, but he has been keeping his distance from her because of his unstable position within his family. Unfortunately, Hadius has already lost Emilia’s trust and must prove his sincerity to gain it back. Will the two be able to overcome adversity and hardship and find a way to be together? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

With a perfect older brother, Yim Ju-Hyeong's inferiority complex has always driven him to be better than other people. Everything goes well until a new transfer student named Yim Se-On shows up. Despite being superior to Ju-Hyeong in every single way, Se-On, for some mysterious reason, seems intent on devoting himself to taking care of Ju-Hyeong. Even though Ju-Hyeong should hate it, he doesn't understand why he can't push Se-On away.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

After losing her professional golfing license due to a failed drug test, the innocent Im Soo-an is forced to find other work. However, the only person she can turn to is her first love - the very same man she coldly dumped in the past! Fortunately, he agrees to help her and manages to find her a job as a caddie, but it’s a far cry from being a professional golfer… To make matters worse, the men at the country club seem to think they can take advantage of her! She just has to deal with their advances until she clears her name, but how…?

Though she helped lead the warriors to victory, no one recognized her efforts, since she was a commoner. Even the warriors themselves did not stand by her side. After regretting giving her all to help the empire, she leaves the capital to start anew, but just as she is settling into her new life, the evil dragon awakens again...

description:
Si-Hu’s life is a pretty good one. He’s starting a new job at a pretty decent company, he’s been happily married to a gorgeous wife for six years, and he’s pretty good-looking himself. But one day, everything starts cracking at the edges when he starts to suspect that his beautiful wife Si-A is having an affair. He can’t stop obsessing and worrying over it, but his pretty coworker Min-A might have the perfect solution: a steamy affair of his own. Si-Hu isn’t sure this is the right thing to do, but it’s hard to say no when his wife is more suspicious than ever and there so many gorgeous women at his office. Suddenly, Sovian is overcome with an insatiable lust that must be quenched, and everyone on the express wants a piece of him. With no place to hide on an unstoppable train, he'll have to service his fellow libidinous travelers until he can make it to his destination. But will his stop ever come? With nobody to fill the empty spot in their group, Hyeongwu is on the verge of losing his opportunity to become an idol—until he stumbles across a strange, handsome man called Yun, who just might be their group’s ticket to stardom. He swallowed once and looked up at the hotel. Today, he hadn’t come to pick up a steak for his boss’s breakfast.

Today was the day he was meeting his boss’s family for marriage.

“Hey. Are you really going to marry me? You don’t even love me.”

Instead of answering, Yeonsim’s thoughts hurried back to two months ago.

***

Executive Director Seong Hyunho, infamous for his scandalous private life, had been caught leaving a hotel with his secretary on the very day of his formal meeting between families. His fiancée immediately called off the engagement, and Hyunho was in the middle of fleeing to avoid the chairman’s wrath.

Na Yeonsim, an employee who had been at the company for only a week, ended up hiding Seong Hyunho—the heir to Taekyung Group—under his desk, even while the chairman thundered in anger.

That was his mistake.

“Work with me.”   
"What... do you mean by that?"   
"I'm scouting you."

He wanted to say no. But Hyunho had taken a liking to Yeonsim’s quick thinking in hiding him and was completely stubborn about it. In the end, Yeonsim began his tearful life as a secretary.

"Just manage my private life."

Forced into becoming Hyunho’s secretary, Yeonsim was given the heavy responsibility of managing his boss’s scandalous private life.

And yet, the one who ended up rolling around in bed with him was Yeonsim himself—drunk out of his mind.

"Inside this peanut shape, this thing—it's beating."   
"What...... what's beating?"   
“The fetus heart.”

Just what exactly is this executive director, who doesn’t even seem surprised after getting a man pregnant?

And can I really give birth safely to this childish man’s baby?

Isaac Esteban, the one I loved and who loved me in return.

He, who had been so devoted to her, suddenly betrayed Calliope for the saintess who had traveled the lands in search for knights to defeat the demon king. He turned his back on Calliope and left to follow Clementia as the chosen knight fated to subjugate the demon king, who is resurrected every 500 years, saying he felt true love for the latter.

Stricken with grief, she lived as if she were in hell for a year. In the end, during the parade for the one-year anniversary celebration of the demon king’s defeat, she climbed up the bell tower and jumped to her death.

“There’s no way I can pay off that debt in my lifetime.”

In the 21st century, humanity was withering away, plagued by repeated nuclear accidents, environmental pollution, and deadly animal flu outbreaks. While we conquered cancer, dementia, and aging, and even solved the problem of global warming with space mirrors, humanity, pouring all its resources into overcoming global warming, spent the next century stagnant in many ways. Around the time humans were forced to abandon not only meat but even companion animals, humanity acknowledged its failure and established an AI government. The first-generation AI, "Virginia," freed humans from the obligation of labor through bold legislation and monetary management. However, it faced numerous trials and errors, one of which was the enactment of the Death with Dignity Act. While the human lifespan approached 200 years, a significant portion of humanity chose euthanasia before the age of 50. Most importantly, the suicide rate among women who advocated for euthanasia was catastrophic. Within 30 years of the Death with Dignity Act, the gender ratio collapsed beyond repair, and humanity's greatest enemy was not war or viruses, but depression and helplessness. The second-generation AI, "Agotha," ordered the abolition of the death with dignity law and the development of innovative antidepressants. Thanks to these drugs, which induce increased libido and short-term memory loss, humanity began to live their days, enjoying polyamory and VR sex. Having brought about meaningful change, "Agotha" entered a long-term reign and ordered polyandry and environmental labor as the only ways to prevent humanity's self-destruction. It was the dawn of the 22nd century.

She spends her days enduring headaches caused by the low-level spirits and worldly agonies only she can see, resigned to the daily torment from her classmates. When the two finally cross paths, the plaque Asura carries to identify the successor glows with a brilliant blue light. "So, it’s you." "Tell me, do you have any interest in becoming a god? for Hyojung, it was a day when she didn't want to care about anything,
a day when she just wanted to go home.
Even to Hyojung, new friends naturally approach,
but opening her heart isn't easy for her.

Amidst this, a story reaches Hyojung's ears.
The subject is a quiet, reserved child in her class.

someone refused his confession,
so Ha-an set something on fire.

description:
The underworld has become a capitalist society.

One must settle their debts, even in death.

“Wait, you’re saying I can’t move on to the afterlife until I settle my debt?”

Cheon Jae-hak died drowning in debt. That news hit him like a ton of bricks right after dying!

Jae-hak, with his taekwondo skills, will join Underworld Capital to collect money from wandering spirits.

From a debtor to the youngest member of a financial firm!

Alright, I’ll earn money and pay off my debt!

A crazy, overpowered occultist who’ll pay off his debt by beating up ghosts!?

Hey, this actually pays pretty well!

For Seok-ho, a young professional, there was something more important than his job or salary: escaping being a lifelong single. Seok-ho starts his dream first relationship but experiences unexpected hardships. Moon Seok-ho, who has transformed from a boy and a soldier into a member of society, is a growth story about love, work, and dreams! `

description:
Gyu-Rye, a second-year student at Yeonriji High School. He is at an age where he should be interested in love and good alarms, but what Gyu-Rye wants most is a lottery ticket to escape from a family that does not pay attention to him. Is he trying to grant his wish? One day, two people appear in front of Gyu-Rye. A game buddy and affectionate son, and a boy who claims to be Han Kang-Rin's childhood friend and makes him feel bad, Ok So-Han. One of these two is a lover from a past life 70 years ago who has a 'shield', and the other is an avenger who has a grudge from a past life with a 'spear'. 

A story of three people's entangled relationships that have continued for over 70 years, with their memories of past and present lives mixed up in a mess.

But that night, Gu-Bongi is whining and can't sleep, so she turns on the dog speaker and hears a single word: "Don't kill my owner!"

A-Ram, who happened to go to the future, saw an impressive movie there and returned to make the same movie, but that work was a work for which Ga-Eun and U-Bin, who are currently film students, had just completed the script. A-Ram, realizing this fact, is obsessed with the desire to create her own work and tries to eliminate Ga-Eun and U-Bin. Ga-Eun and U-Bin fight against A-Ram to survive and to retrieve their future and precious works that were stolen by A-Ram.

One day, when Lee Seon gets hurt before an important event, Lee Ryeong pretends to be Lee Seon for a month and lives her younger brother's life. description:
“Pretty person! I like you!” 

A 17-year-old dog-type who moved to Seoul from the countryside to find a new best friend, ‘Yuu’ meets ‘Robin’, a cat-type who is beautiful from head to toe, on the first day of school and makes a 100% straightforward confession. 

The two part ways without even exchanging names due to the annoying ringing of the bell, knowing Robin’s pounding heart. Yuu follows her scent to meet her again and debuts as a student council worker… 

The straightforward dog-type Yuu and the proud lover Robin’s crazy school life begins now! 

(source: Peanutoon, translated)

On his way to school as a senior, Parang feels nothing in particular. But into his colorless, monotonous daily life comes an unexpected variable: his first love.

*“Sir! Later on… please marry me!”*

However, his confessions, which continue for a whole year, fail every single time. On the snowy day of graduation, one word from Juhwan leads Parang to postpone university and decide to enlist in the military. As time passes, Parang, who thought he would never see Juhwan again, ends up reuniting with him by fate in an unexpected place.

*“Sir, I don’t have anywhere to stay. Could you let me stay just for one night…?”  
“Okay. You can stay.”*

Thus begins their sudden cohabitation-

Will Parang finally be able to achieve the first love he has longed for?

This is a graphic novel that tells the story of witches living in a world facing a crisis due to environmental pollution and climate change. We have spent a summer where “many things crumbled silently.” Things dried up and crumbled in the scorching heat, and melted, decayed, and swept away by merciless torrential rains. Such brutal summers are getting longer with each passing year. This book is for those who endure this never-ending season with a throbbing heart that refuses to heal, lamenting the destruction and disappearance of their loved ones. Although the helplessness and guilt of feeling like there is nothing to be done amidst this massive flow of destruction sicken the mind, this book says: since there are more things that have survived than those that have lived, we must care for one another. 

This is our story, and it is also the story of the witches living in Mansinnaru. In a world where nature has ailing, the grandeur of calming waves with a glance and building forests with a single gesture has become a glory of the past. Now, they are confined to a witches' sanctuary called Mansinnaru. I am slowly dying, suffering from an incurable disease that causes parts of my body to burn black like a leaf afflicted by blight. Yet, I continue to live on, planting in the field a potato I carelessly picked up at the supermarket that had sprouted, declaring it fate, and making and sharing jam-making cakes made from figs that survived heavy rains. Just like us, who strive to maintain our daily lives and care for those around us, even in moments of helplessness. 

(Source: Goble, translated)

Joo Seo-Ah and Nam Do-Hyeon have been inseparable friends since middle school, sharing a bond that always felt like equal ground. However, following the implementation of the new age unification law, a technicality shifts their dynamic: Do-Hyeon is officially younger than Seo-Ah. Heartbroken by a recent breakup and nursing a specific craving for the comfort of a firm, youthful younger man to spite her ex, Seo-Ah decides to exploit this sudden age gap. She turns to Do-Hyeon, whose birthday falls just months after hers, and issues a playful yet daring challenge. 

"Hey, Nam Do-Hyeon. Call me Noona," she demands. To her surprise, Do-Hyeon actually stammers it out, looking flustered and endearingly shy. Seeing him blush makes Seo-Ah’s heart skip a beat; she suddenly finds him dangerously cute. Panicked, she realizes she’s crossing a line she can't uncross. If he starts looking this adorable, she’s in serious trouble. What on earth is she supposed to do now?

Geralt trails the mythical Lady of Snow in this original manga taking the witcher to new lands inspired by ancient Japan. In a new world inspired by Edo-period Japan, Geralt is faced with difficult moral choices while battling a variety of yokai and oni, creatures inspired by Japanese myths. Each encounter drops a clue in his desperate search for a mysterious apparition known as the Lady of Snow, yuki onna, for she is the key to who Geralt seeks, but finding her won't be easy.

Presenting a new story in The Witcher universe based on the rich traditions of Japanese folklore. Here, the role of a witcher is just as essential--as dangerous spirits and demons are constantly on the prowl.

Dismayed by the havoc wreaked on the Earth by humans, its five guardian spirits decide to act. But as they argue amongst themselves on what the judgement should be, one enraged spirit, Nila, becomes determined to take matters into her own hands, forcing the remaining four to unite in a desperate final battle to prevent her from wiping not just humankind, but all life from the face of the planet.

This is a highly personal and timely book that features some of Eldo’s most beautiful artwork to date. With its central themes of ecology, philosophy and spirituality, Hen Kai Pan is a kinetic, emotionally charged work that delivers a powerful message that will resonate not just with manga fans, but all readers.

“Hen Kai Pan” translates as “One and All”, and is the motto of Cosmotheism.

After many years of social tension due to the various climatic and health crises, governments had to face the rise of a determined ecological movement accusing the Capitalist system of being responsible for the situation, endangering the future of the planet and humankind alike.

The people's revolt became global, in the same way as the economy.

The "Green riots" led many countries to civil war and chaos.

About twenty years will be needed for society to reorganize and find a relative balance between two opposed worlds that still coexist. One advocates for progress and economic growth in large, highly secured modern cities. The other favors decay and return to a life more in harmony with nature.

The governments agreed to accommodate more environmentally friendly economic policies and made health a top priority. They enforced the "Seed" biotechnological chip implantation as mandatory for all human beings. The "Seed", created by the DARWIN Biogenetic company, allows for real-time individual health monitoring. It detects the slightest abnormal biological symptom and thus prevents many diseases and potential epidemics.

(Source: Webtoon)

In a city of clockwork, the worst day of Lyllian’s life ends in tragedy: Her date murdered by a warrior who shouldn’t exist. As Lyllian’s own fight for survival unravels the mystery of her world, she learns of those known as Soulwinders—Whose powers have the potential to recover what she lost. Remember… DON’T CALM DOWN!

(Source: Webtoon)

Mills is your average high school senior, despite having 2 super-agent dads who take down highly dangerous criminals. But during an attack on the city, his dads' arch nemesis, Shadowmaker, ends up saving his life! Being rescued by a supervillain is strange, but it only gets stranger when Shadowmaker asks him out on a date!

- Webtoons

The year is 2008. The On siblings have moved from Korea to America, and there's a lot more to get used to than just being the new kids in school. Join So-won and Woo as they try to find their footing in Los Angeles.
Source: Webtoon

William is a city boy who has just turned 18. He’s finally old enough to do everything he wants, right? But his life is turned upside down when his family moves to the country, putting the brakes on all his big plans. Will he resist his new life, or will he let new relationships in?

(Source: Webtoon)

Kyoungmi thought she had it all—an amazing best friend, a sweet boyfriend and fame after writing a critically acclaimed drama series. She should be happy... Right? Yet, two years later, Kyoungmi is struggling to write the next big thing. Searching for inspiration at a popular new café, she reunites with old classmates, one of whose feelings for her never truly faded. Could these fateful meetings between Kyoungmi and her friends be the start of something fresh? Or will this lead to a bitter end?

(Source: Webtoon)

Mateo’s greatest dream is to travel the stars as an astronaut, but a magical mishap in a supply closet throws him into a world fantasy. There, he can take on the forms the magical denizens and use their powers, but at the price of slowly weakening his sole connection to earth: his humanity. Mateo must find a cure for his magic before he’s trapped in a realm without electricity for good!
Source: Webtoon
Marcus has a crush, and Cog is completely unprepared for the hijinks that follow. Hopefully in their efforts to grow closer, they can brighten each other's day.

display_title: I Made a Deal With the Devil
mangabaka_title: I Made a Deal With the Devil

titles.title: Eu fiz um acordo com o diabo
Eu fiz um contrato com o diabo
I Made a Deal With the Devil

description:
Shamelessly betrayed by her fiance and cruelly framed by her family, Eva Young swore to herself that she would make everyone who had wronged her regret. She would pay them back tenfold or more… even if it means she had to make a deal with the devil himself!

She was fully prepared to pay a heavy price in exchange for getting what she wanted - vengeance! However, the surprisingly handsome devil only wanted one simple kiss from her every night? Wait... What? That was all? Was he being serious?!

Finn just wants to draw his comics in peace. Not everybody needs to know he’s a closeted nerd. But when his cousin, Vivi, claims that a video game character look-alike walked into her classroom, Finn's comics and personal life begin to take a strange turn.

(Source: Webtoon)

For centuries, adventurers have slaughtered monsters for sport and hunted goblins for their body parts and linens. But why? This is the question, Nog, the goblin inventor, has been trying to answer. After accidentally unlocking an arcane power that allows Nog to "level up" and grow in strength, he finally discovers the confidence to chase the answer to his question. Nog will set on a perilous quest across the world with his best friend, Gubble, to discover why humans hunt goblins! Can monsters and adventurers live in peace? 

- Webtoons

Seen as a problematic high school student, Joel Mora is feared by all. That is, until Emma, a shy girl from his class, decides to get to know him better. Now, Joel is in the middle of a social whirlwind, trying to find his place.

(Source: Webtoon)

How can one post online turn the life of Christopher, a happy-go-lucky high school student, upside down? His love of movies and tv shows takes him to an online message board where he meets and starts to develop feelings for the illusive and untraceable Lucas19. Tired of not knowing who he is talking to, Christopher tries to sleuth his way around the internet to find out, but much to his avail, he finds no clues at all. Who is this mysterioso and what will happen between them?

(Source: Webtoon)

Kalisa is a young star who has fallen from the heavens and finds herself in an entirely new world where she is held captive by a young king. All alone and with no memory of her past, Kalisa escapes from the kingdom to find a way back home. With the help of new friends that she meets along the way, Kalisa embarks on a journey to break the curse she's under and return home to the stars. However, will she be able to do all this before the king finds her?

(Source: Webtoon)

Escaping a political marriage and her glowing crown were just the start of Lilinae’s journey. Becoming the queen of Shootend, meeting her two knights, and braving hostile kingdoms to get back home — that’s where things get interesting.

- Webtoons

As a fehru-alchemist, Dave should not exist, but then, a lot of things should not exist. After a disturbing turn of events, Dave finds himself returning to Rhi-Daton, the very city he escaped from years ago. Meanwhile, a strange woman with mysterious powers joins forces with the merciless House Dawn to intercept a peculiar weapon before it falls into the wrong hands. Things take a turn for the worse when the city unexpectedly closes its gates. Trapped inside with no way out, Dave runs into Leto, a fellow alchemist. Together, the duo must uncover the secrets of the past and prevent the disaster from unraveling further than it already has.

(Source: Webtoon)

Long ago, demons came into the land of Laevus. Pride, Greed, Sloth, Wrath, Lust, Gluttony... each one plaguing one of the six districts. There is one demon, however, who is the most powerful of all and destined to bring about the end of all humanity: the Absolute. Ina Venus, a legendary demon hunter from the lowest of the six districts, was born as an Unstable demon, and he is inches away from becoming the Absolute himself. One fateful night, Ina is forced to face one of his most formidable foes yet: himself. Will Ina be able to find humanity within himself before it's too late, or will he succumb to his demonic side and cause destruction to all?
Source: Webtoon

Fai's visions always come true, and they've gotten worse just before the new transfer students arrive. What could Fai and her new friends possibly do to avoid the doom that was promised? Good thing they're not regular kids at all!
Source: Webtoon

When humans can shift into animals, manipulate elemental powers, or possess weapons created from otherworldly metals, things undoubtedly escalate quickly. Still, as an extremist cult emerges to dominate the one city that unites the three species, a powerful corporation recruits a secret task force to challenge them.
Source: Webtoon

After moving away for a decade, Rhea returns to the bustling city on her quest for independence. Things are looking bleak, until she bumps into a familiar face - one she didn't think she would ever see again. Feelings rekindle as secrets begin to unfold, Rhea soon realizes her childhood friend may not be who she believes him to be, and thus her most cherished relationship is put to the test.
Source: Webtoon

When the world was new, the twelve star signs descended to bless humanity with magic according to their date of birth. Fourteen worthy people, called the “Realta,” were given a star from each Sign that allowed them to receive prophecies of the future called “horoscopes” and summon great power to defeat the Fae: beings that tormented humanity. However, much has changed since Elowen was a child. Magic is illegal, the Fae are getting stronger, and the Realta have been forgotten…until our Virgo meets a certain Capricorn.
Source: Webtoon

A lonely necromancer resurrects a beautiful woman in exchange for a reward from a wealthy client, but nothing can prepare him for the deep connection that develops between him and his "monster".

(Source: Webtoon)

Hunted since birth for a burden he unknowingly carries, Yu must discover the secrets of his origins and his ties to a hidden shinobi world so he can come to realize the weight of his destiny, of being the last hope…the Last Flame of humanity standing against an ancient demonic threat.

(Source: Webtoon)

In the midst of a centuries-long war between mechanized Miez and beastly Coriez, Sun and Count hunt for a colossal Coriez from their forgotten past. Their journey introduces them to new friends on new planets, but they'll soon learn that their travels come at a cost, and some things are better left hidden.
Source: Webtoon

Vainqueur Knightsbane is your average dragon: a fire-breathing lizard who loves to sleep on his golden hoard, kidnap princesses for fun, and make the life of adventurers miserable. Vainqueur's only pleasure in life is to watch his treasure get bigger, one coin at a time. So when a would-be thief turned unwilling minion tells him about "classes," "levels," and "quests," Vainqueur wonders if he should consider a career change. Can the world survive the first dragon with levels?

(Source: Tapas)

In modern-day Paris, 20-year old Christine Daaé is an aspiring opera singer whose dreams were shattered by a traumatic incident during an audition one year ago. She has all but given up on returning to the stage, until a mysterious voice on the roof of the Paris Opera House offers her the chance to get her life back. But in order to achieve her dreams, she'll have to ask herself if she's willing to believe in this ghost… and if she can trust him. A modern retelling of "The Phantom of the Opera" by Gaston Leroux.

- Webtoons

When Addie’s twin sister, Beatrice, falls ill before a presentation that could make or break her career, Addie agrees to impersonate her at work. But what was supposed to be a one-time favor turns into a long-term, high stakes sister swap when the cold, stern CEO likes one of Addie’s ideas. Now the sisters have to keep switching back and forth on the job. But with the CEO starting to fall for Addie and the cute front desk guy in love with Beatrice, can the twin sisters manage to keep up the con without breaking anyone’s hearts?

Source: Tapas

After creating the song that could catapult his band into further success, Alex (leader of the band Noir Bril) wakes up to find his unconscious body bludgeoned on the ground. Stuck in between the worlds of the living and the dead, Alex is running out of time before his chance to return to the living world is gone forever. Desperate to return to his body, he is lead to a medium named Sasha. All Sasha wants is to finally live a life far away from the supernatural world that surrounds her. But, her plans take a turn as soon as Alex comes along.

- Webtoons

Not all knights wield armor and swords; some are capable of summoning ethereal weapons known as "Animas". And if you are strong enough, you might be able to join the legendary Knight's Order. As part of the Knight's Order, your duty is to protect and serve the people. Theresa, however, has her own goals, and that is to find the white-haired knight. She'll make any sacrifice to do so. But what will she do when her pursuit for a single silver thread unravels the entire fabric that hides a sinister truth about knights and the world that they live in?
Source: Webtoon

Sein, a child of unknown origin, embarks on a lone journey throughout the mystical and dangerous world of Mirra. Sein's master, the Great Sage, was forced to part ways with him in order to do battle with a fearsome foe. On his own, Sein slowly discovers his true self, meets friends along the way, and experiences things he couldn't while under the Great Sage's watchful protection. Upon discovering more about himself, he learns he harbors a power strong enough to become the world's greatest hero... or its greatest nightmare!
Source: Webtoon

All Zack wanted to do was to make his dad proud by opening a restaurant but when demonic creatures awaken and threaten to destroy it all, some things get moved to the back burner.
Source: Webtoon

What’s it like to work at an office where all of your bosses are literal gods and goddesses? Iris, a young human woman, is swept into the world of divine bureaucracy as a mailroom assistant in the corporate HQ of the Olympians themselves! But this is no easy place for a human to be, and she’s already gotten off on the wrong foot with two handsome demigods: the fiery, short-tempered Dante, and the stoic but gentle Orion. As she grows closer to them both, can she keep her personal and professional lives separate while surviving Eros’ antics, Aphrodite’s temper, and Hermes’ pranks?

Source: Tapas

Cassia works a Dead-End job, lives in a cramped apartment, and can't remember her own last name. Good thing she has a sexy vampire boyfriend who lives in her dreams- if only he were real, then maybe life wouldn't suck so bad.

- Webtoonsw

Being the daughter of two war criminals, Ray has grown up ostracized and hated by many. After a chance encounter with an infamous commander, she is suddenly driven into multiple situations that put her morals to the test—all the while the phantoms of her parents’ legacy constantly looms over her.

(Source: Webtoon)

When Jack meets Kate, he's sure that they're meant to be. But just when life seems poised to prove him wrong, he finds himself in a loop that keeps him pursuing her...forever. With no clues to lead his path, other than the moment they meet and her tragic fate, Jack races against the infinitely ticking clock to save Kate and break the time loop for good.

- Webtoons

After an attempted kidnapping, Ellie finds herself under the protection of a secret society. She has to work to earn her keep, and in doing so she slowly learns more about her foggy past. In the midst of dealing with monsters and a whole new world of magic, her heart is starting to feel something new to her as well.

(Source: Webtoons)

In a world of humans and monsters, Visare is a young vampire obsessed with his favorite anime, Bunny Tenshi. When he finds a magic pendant, he embarks on a quest to save his missing sister. Facing mad scientists, robots, and other monsters, will he be able to become a hero like Bunny Tenshi? Or will his own powers betray him?
Source: Webtoon

In a world filled with superheroes, can a person who is immortal, but only has the strength of a normal human, become one of the best? Who knows, but Tai is dead set on trying. More series by Yaruno: Glacias and Spirit Warriors

(Source: Webtoons)

Life was never easy for Finn. After her dad left and her mom passed away, she raised herself and her little brother on her own. And when her beloved boss is hospitalized, she takes responsibility for the bookstore she calls home. But the return of the owner’s estranged son throws a wrench in the works. Finn’s opposite, Cormac is rough where she’s sweet, and he knows how to push all of her buttons. But even as the two clash, there’s more to Cormac than meets eye… is this the change Finn needs in her life?
Source: Tapas

After learning that she is cursed with magical abilities, Cydonia is cast out by her people. But when King Maelkyr starts wiping out entire villages using an ancient, magical monstrosity, she vows to use her curse to stop him from destroying her cherished way of life.
Source: Webtoon

Ancient god, Eros, has an insatiable hunger for one thing humans desire most - love. Eros longs to be free of his vicious cravings, but is quickly met with even greater challenges. While seeking redemption, Eros is confronted by power-hungry gods with equally sinister appetites - all whom want nothing more than to see his downfall. But as Eros is continuously tested by the gods around him, he begins to question not only their purpose...but his own.
Source: Webtoon

One tragic night, Caine survives a brutal assault when a demonic entity known as a Key saves his life. With his chance at a normal life long gone, Caine must accept his fate as a Key Holder possessed with remarkable supernatural power. But this power comes with a price. The Key inhabiting Caine has its own goal: the eradication of every other Key. Caine must harness the strength of his Key to find his place in the hidden world of hostile Exorcists, sinister Keys, and a network that spreads far beyond his hometown of Derry, Northern Ireland.
Source: Webtoon

While scavenging the outskirts of the Wildlands, Athemis discovers a unique compass that points deeper in. Together with her friend Erri, she decides to explore the mysteries behind the curious compass and its destination. But an object that valuable doesn’t go unnoticed for long. Its very existence threatens to shatter the already fragile peace of the citizens inside the magic barrier, who are on the brink of a civil war. As interests surrounds Athemis and Erri, they will not only face danger from the treacherous Wildlands outside the Barrier, but also from the chaos within.
Source: Webtoon

Annie Green, a 16-year-old girl who has always had a hard time getting close to girls, faces the worst rumor going around school... that she hates them! That’s not true at all! Annie will fight to deny this false rumor and will try to achieve what she has always wanted: to make friends with girls. Her friends Eugene and Colin will accompany her on this incredible adventure full of misunderstandings and embarrassing situations. Meanwhile, some feelings and friendships will emerge in this group of students. Will they be able to face all these challenges?

- Webtoons

Mallory was a naive college student until she stumbled into the dangerous world of international vampires. After a prophecy names her the new “Queen of Vampires,” she needs to earn the title or risk falling into the clutches of those who seek to destroy her.

- Webtoons

Henley never thought she'd see so many zeros on one check—$10,000 to be billionaire Bennett Calloway's fake girlfriend?! And that's just the advance! She's barely scraping by, working two minimum wage jobs just to afford the worst apartment ever and the lawyer fees from her brother's wrongful conviction. Calloway is rude and entitled, but the opportunity seems too good to pass up. The only catch? Don't fall in love. In desperate need of cash, Henley finds herself caught up in a whirlwind business arrangement, pretending to date Calloway so his mother will ease up on the pressure for him to find a wife. But once Henley is enmeshed in Bennett's world, he falls for her, and she starts to develop feelings for him as well. Despite her romance with Bennett, it's clear something is wrong—are the Calloways involved in the conviction that put her brother in jail? What secrets are their family hiding? Journeying deeper into a world of wealth and conspiracies, Henley is forced to rely on Bennett. But how much can she really trust him... when doing so could cost her everything?

Source: Tapas

After a car accident, fashion designer Madison wakes up inside her favorite fairy tale as Allena, the daughter of the villainess Irene! For years Irene and Allena have lived in banishment. But there is an untold story—the truth is Irene was never a real villainess. She was framed! Using her fashion skills, Allena enters the noble finishing school, Versailles Academy, swearing to earn the prestigious title of First Lady of Versailles so she can clear Irene’s name and find her own happy ending.
Source: Tapas

Jennifer's life completely changed after her mother died. Her old cheer squad and ex-boyfriend made that very clear as she fell from their social ranks. It wasn't until she discovered her mother's old spellbook that Jennifer got her second chance: to find her mom's soul, and tell her "I love you" one last time. But when the spell opens a window to Hell; she doesn't find her mother on the other side- but instead a handsome Devil Prince who may hold the key to unlocking her new abilities...

- Webtoons

What if the victim of bullying suddenly becomes attractive. Do you still want to bully him again? Or it will become a new problem for the bully. Arthur had enough bullying by Elsa and being called meat buns. One day he decided to exercise to lose some weight in hopes of not getting bullied again. But something happened and changed his life forever.

(Source: Webtoon Canvas EN)

Felicity’s sure she’s going to do something big. Exactly what is still a mystery, but she’ll figure it out. Her sister, Letty, teases Felicity that she never finishes stuff, but that’s just because Letty is so perfect. Still, life is good with plenty of friends—drawing with the art club and playing games with her buddies keep her busy. But when she decides to join a contest to show Letty that she can get things done, Felicity begins to wonder if friends becoming enemies is easier than she thought. Are they really enemies, though…? What does it even mean to be enemies? And...who is it that she needs the most on her side...?

In a world where falling in love makes you stronger, Molly is forced into entering a hellish arena called Love and Gore by her new boyfriend, Desmond Tresno. Turns out that her first opponent is actually Desmond's ex-girlfriend, whom he's still not over with. Will Molly be able to find true love and survive the bloody battleground?
Source: Lezhin

Tale of Genji tells the story of Prince Genji, the passionate heir to the Chrysanthemum Throne. Handsome, romantic, and talented in the art of seduction, Prince Genji skillfully navigates the court and all its intrigues--always in search of love and often finding it. His story is the oldest and most famous tale of romance in the annals of Japanese literature and, as a representation of passion and romance, remains beyond compare.
Source: Tuttle Publishing

Amber Everton wakes up one day to discover that his younger brother, Aaron, has completely vanished, along with all of his possessions and everyone else's memory of him. Only Amber and his best friend Wes can remember Aaron, and so they set out to find him, discovering strange magic and dark forces at play in the shadows.
Source: Webtoon

Ayeka is a talented, but hot-headed agent for the Deep Garden, a secret organization tasked with exorcising spectral entities known as "Spiders". But when more powerful Spiders start to appear, Ayeka's recklessness will both help and harm her, as she embarks on a journey to discover the secrets of the mysterious Black Compass project. Will she lose herself in her findings? Or will she gain the power to send the Spiders back to Hell?
Source: Webtoon

When Princess Nova’s beloved knight, Eric, is tasked with the impossible mission of capturing a legendary wolf on her behalf, Nova decides to reverse their roles— she’ll catch the wolf for him instead! But when Nova pursues the wolf, she discovers that he’s actually the beautiful but cursed Prince Aron of the Northern Kingdom, doomed to search endlessly for the one knight who can break his spell. If Nova herself is Aron’s knight (gasp!), can she break his curse and return to Eric in one piece?
Source: Tapas
Includes 1 extra chapter.

Annie is a lonely girl who is afraid of mirrors, while Liam is a well-known model and actor. It may seem unlikely that two people with such different lives could relate to each other, but sometimes, people's external appearance doesn't reflect their true souls. This is the story of two broken hearts and their journey toward self-acceptance and love. 

(Source: Webtoon)

Steve is a builder that just wants to mine materials and craft in peace, but the mysterious monster girls that surround him wont leave him in peace!

(Source: Webtoons)

She might only walk dogs now, but Cece dreams of joining the world of high fashion with her unique and stunning designs. But with barely any money for materials, let alone for rent; she'll need a miracle in the form of a lost dog to give her the opportunity of a lifetime. Will she finally reach her goal, or will a new passion spark new dreams?

(Source: Webtoon)

College student, Josiah Liu finds himself unexpectedly thrown into the body of the character, Zachary Wahlberg, the 2nd Male Lead of the novel his sister is obsessed about.

Scrambling to get back to his own world, he has to complete the storyline of the novel successfully.

How hard can that be?

Evidently it is.

(Source: Tapas)
If the world fell apart and you could do nothing but survive, how would you do it? What purpose or peace can you find when all that remains is the ruins of the past?

As a broke college student, Kay needs to find a place to settle down in the cheapest way possible. Her solution? Having a roommate! Little did she know, that her previous high school friend Cam is also experiencing the same housing issue. Even though they’re polar opposites of each other, they agree to become roommates. Will they be able to live comfortably together? Their day-to-day life shenanigans start... now!

(Source: Webtoon)
Noah is a quiet boy looking for a meaning in his life, his days will disappear after he meets Kaleb, a drugGGG user who has a big bounty on his head.

In the year 2050, an 18 year-old amnesiac woman wakes up to a desperate world overrun by monsters. Guided by an artificial superintelligence, a ruthless scientist unleashes hell on Earth to preserve only a fraction of humankind. Love and war await as the mysteries of this corrupt new world unfold!

(Source: Tapas)

For most of his life, Erik Dansen has always been alone. At a very young age, he became an orphan, and was forced to live and survive independently. For many years, Erik wondered how long he would get by. There was no denying that sadness existed. In his heart and in his mind, his everyday life. One morning, a woman knocked on Erik's door, a woman named Elsbeth who would soon change his life.

(Source: Webtoons)
When Kumi took a leap of faith everything changed. For the first time in her life she decided to put herself first. Though objections were made, Kumi needed a fresh start.

Nanami discovers that his new roomate is a writer that he looks up to, and moreover, the writer happens to commission an anonymous artist not knowing it's Nanami! 

- Webtoons

Promises are easy to make but hard to keep. Alex swore to himself he would never fall in love again after his past relationship. But, hey, i guess even promises made to ourselves are hard to keep?

- Webtoons

An international, all-star creative team of writers and artists presents ETERNALS: THE 500 YEAR WAR! Follow the Eternals in their past encounters against the Deviants in this original 7 episode series! Learn how the Eternals interacted with different cultures of the human race across time, gifting humanity with cultural artifacts while also trying to keep them safe from the Deviant threat. It’s a battle that spans centuries, with the fate of the planet at stake!

- Webtoons

When Jaewon jokingly said he wanted a sugar daddy to financially support his ramen-fueled broke college student lifestyle, he didn't expect TWO ALPHAS to actually propose to court him. He accepts, but it isn't like he likes them - he's just doing it for free noodles. Also because he likes being spoiled by two loving, gentle, handsome Alphas. "BUT MOSTLY FOR THE RAMEN, I SWEAR." - Kim Jaewon 2022

To save her younger brother, Marchioness Harriet Goldlane became a substitute mate for Liam Almandine, the dying Alpha of the Almandine Pack. His mate died long ago. The pack wanted Harriet to give birth to an heir from Liam's seed so that their family would have a new leader after he died. Unfortunately, the Alpha was severely injured and could only wake up during full moon nights. Could Harriet accomplish her mission?

(Source: Webtoon)

After moving away for a decade, Rhea returns to the bustling city on her quest for independence. Things are looking bleak, until she bumps into a familiar face - one she didn't think she would ever see again. Feelings rekindle as secrets begin to unfold, Rhea soon realizes her childhood friend may not be who she believes him to be, and thus her most cherished relationship is put to the test. 

- Webtoons

After the heroes battled the Demon Lord, he escaped death by splitting his life essences into 5 seperate spirits. These spirits now haunt the land of Gaoran, taking over humans and devastating the land. After many years the spirit of Wrath takes over a young woman who defies the Demon Lords will. But what will happen when she meets the decendant of the last surviving Hero, from the legendary battle against the Dark Lord of Monsters?

- Webtoons

In a world where werewolves and humans have been at war constantly, Alexandra struggles to keep a promise she made to her deceased mother. An adventure she dares to take will bring her closer to the truth. One that will not only change her life, but also the future of the empire.

- Webtoons

They say it takes 10,000 hours to master a skill, but for Nero Ermen and the citizens of Potentia that saying carries much more weight. In a world where your talent can manifest itself into a Mastery, it’s up to our hero, Nero Ermen, to fully master his abilities in order to uncover the truth behind the government and his powers.

After ruining his parents, Taku Volkov finds himself on a cruise ship to learn about "real life" and the value of money. He unwillingly becomes an employee on this luxury cruise, but what he doesn't know is that his first love ends up working alongside him. It is then that what he thought was just a nightmare turns out to be one for him because he was dumped without explanation by him. How will he live this reunion?

A recent surge of human deaths have drawn the attention of Hell's nastiest demons, and it's up to the human loving angel, Michael, to save their souls! But Michael is in for a rude awakening -literally- when he realizes humans may not be as perfect as he once thought. By living alongside the very creatures he's sworn to protect, growing closer to the church volunteer Daniel, and succumbing to a mortal's most vulnerable emotion... can he save all of humanity?

- Webtoons

Five years after his divorce, Johnny Light found himself employed by private detective Terry Koh in Harbour Bay, a lawless city South of Singapore, where he met the Italian-Korean girl by the name of Minjeong Cassano. 

(Source: MangaDex)

titles.title: Remember Me: The Story of Lang Wen

description:
Jinshuilang, a mer, tries to atone for his past mistakes that killed his best friend, Huoliu. He was able to save Huoliu's soul for reincarnation. After a century of searching and regretting not having realized his feelings for Huoliu sooner, he finally finds the reincarnation of his best friend, now a human named Wen Honglin. But the price of a second chance may be more than he can bear. 

- Webtoons

Welcome to Beavertown, also known as The Beevs. Sets in a couple of months into the future, The Beevs is the last remaining bastion of hipsters, geeks, and freaks. In this webcomic, we follow Tay, Gabby, and friends on their crazy lives in this weird-ass town.

An unlikely relationship blossoms. Do opposites attract? Or will their differences tear them apart? Follow the story of the goth girl Ophelia and the popular footballer Tyler, as they go through their high school life, sitting next to each other in class!

(Source: Webtoons)

Seo Jimin lives by three rules, and a significant lesson from her parents, never get too close to anyone. She loves her independence, avoiding long-term connections. It’s all about the enjoyment without the relationship drama. This approach might get her a bad reputation at the university, but it prevents heartache, especially for her. Then, a strikingly beautiful neighbour arrives…

(Source: Webtoon)

In a land plagued by undying souls shattered into their mortal bodies, an unwilling hero must rise to meet their destined duty to restore the wavering energies of the universe. The Fallen, threatens life's very existence when the balance of all things shifts for the worse. When the Tendrils of Fate pass over, The Era of the Beast shall either end in restored harmony or collapse under chaotic frequencies that hold reality together.

Gemi Reynolds just landed her dream tech job -- how did it put her at the top of someone's hit list? Suddenly she’s pulled into a world of cybercrime, where secretive hackers race to stay ahead of relentless bounty hunters. The only person who can keep her safe? Jack Travis, the very detective-turned-bounty hunter who’s been hired to arrest her. But Jack's own mysterious past is catching up to him, and he may need Gemi's help to stay alive.

- Webtoons

titles.title: ตัวร้ายอย่างฉันก็เป็นเจ้าหญิงนะ!

description:
Abandoned by the Heavenly Demon, the ruler of all demons, Dokgo Yeon-Mi takes in Dokgo Cheon, a baby resembling the heavens themselves. As they attempt to live the life of the Dokgo clan, unconnected to either the Heavenly Demon or the Divine Cult, the Heavenly Demon reappears before them. Due to a twist of fate, Dokgo Yeon-Mi is destined to become a priestess, and to protect her, Dokgo Cheon devotes himself to the Divine Cult... 

*'If the Heavenly Demon stands in my way, I will become the Heavenly Demon!'*

Dokgo Cheon's sword begins to cleave the world against the Heavenly Demon who shattered his peace!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
In the Ten-Gen era, Yun Zhongxuan the Seventh Prince, who possesses great power and is also the Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Rei, had closed himself off emotionally due to repeated assassination attempts and betrayals. One day, Zhongxuan meets his new servant, Youli. Although he tries to take jabs at Youli, who seems a bit scatterbrained from the very first day, Zhongxuan begins to take an interest in the young man’s unyielding spirit. After Youli saves him from being poisoned, Zhongxuan opens his heart to him.

 *“Swear to serve me until the day you die. Do you understand, Youli?”*

And three years later, the day when Zhongxuan will come of age, the first step toward fulfilling his dream, is just one day away. 

(Source: BeLTOON, translated)

description:
While trying to hide the fact that he’s an alpha, Hayden is approached by Brett for help on a class project. However, it turns out that Brett is not only a fellow alpha, but one that doesn’t use scent blockers. The two naturally butt heads and continue as a series of unsettling encounters unfold…until Brett takes things one step too far. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Prince Yun, the eldest son of Nan Gi Kingdom, was pushed off a cliff by his younger brother.
He survives and meets a kind dragon, Ev, and they quickly become friends and make a plan together.
They built their own kingdom and started gathering allies to take revenge on his family of traitors.

description:
*“Just like my sisters, I’ll seduce men and wrap them around my little finger—one by one!”* 

Long ago, in an age of myths and mountains, a family of gumiho sisters thrived by charming travelers and stealing their essence. Life was sweet—until the youngest, Arang, suddenly declares she’s heading to the human world to seduce a man of her own. Mischievous, naïve, and fiercely determined, Arang is ready to unleash her foxy charm. But in the world of humans, love doesn’t always follow the rules of magic... and this little fox might just get caught in her own trap. 

(Source: Lezhin US)
